cards.mood: The piece opens with a burst of high-energy, celebratory brass fanfare that immediately establishes a vibrant and kinetic mood.
cards.palette: The piano serves as the primary harmonic driver, comping with rhythmic chord stabs and occasional melodic fills from the intro through to the outro.

cards.mood: The piece launches with an immediate, high-energy burst of brass fanfare, establishing a celebratory and confident tone.
cards.palette: A full brass and saxophone ensemble serves as the primary melodic and harmonic driver, present from the Intro through the Outro.

cards.mood: The piece launches with an explosive, high-energy brass fanfare that immediately establishes a celebratory and confident tone.
cards.palette: A full acoustic brass section (trumpets, trombones) and woodwind section (saxophones) enter immediately for the intro hits, drop to background swells during verses, and return with powerful unison lines and harmonies…
